Area Forecast Discussion
National Weather Service Baltimore MD/Washington DC
1018 AM EDT Thu May 28 2026

.WHAT HAS CHANGED...
No changes to the forecast. Drier conditions on the way over the
next several days.

&&

.KEY MESSAGES...
- 1) No hazardous weather expected through early next week

&&

.DISCUSSION...
KEY MESSAGE 1...No hazardous weather expected through early next 
week. 

Drier air will continue to push into the region from the
northwest and north through tomorrow as high pressure builds
into the northwest. This high will move offshore over the
weekend and keep the area dry. Seasonable temperatures expected
this afternoon and tomorrow.

A northern stream upper level low will drop a reinforcing (and 
dry) cold front through region early Saturday, delivering extra
cloud cover. Expect highs in the 70s (60s mountains) through 
Tuesday and overnight lows in the 40s and 50s. Upper level 
ridging persists through the middle of next week with a gradual 
warming trend expected.

&&

.AVIATION /14Z THURSDAY THROUGH MONDAY/...
VFR conditions are expected through early next week. Northwest 
winds gust around 20-25 knots this afternoon. Light north winds
tomorrow, then a reinforcing cold front brings a surge of 
northwest winds (gusting 20-25 knots) on Saturday.

&&

.MARINE...
Some gusty northwest winds this afternoon behind a cold front.
SCA conditions across all waters this afternoon and evening. 
Peak gusts around 25 knots expected. Sub- SCA level winds return
to the waters tomorrow into tomorrow night, high pressure 
overhead. Additional SCAs likely needed Saturday afternoon and 
evening due to southerly channeling. Sub- SCA winds Sunday 
through Tuesday at this time.

&&
